item.title: The Mathematical Essence of Deep Neural Networks: From Composite Functions to Gradient Descent
item.author: 0make@gmail.com (AZ)
item.description:
Introduction

When we marvel at the amazing capabilities of artificial intelligence, we rarely think about the mathematical foundation behind it. In fact, the essence of Deep Neural Networks (DNN), mathematically, is an extremely complex composite function. It fits the mapping relationship between input data and output results through nested layers of simple linear transformations and non-linear activation functions.

item.title: Reinforcement Learning (RL) Development History
item.author: 0make@gmail.com (AZ)
item.description:
Reinforcement Learning (RL) is one of the three core paradigms of machine learning (alongside supervised learning and unsupervised learning).

Its core idea is: An agent learns the optimal policy through trial and error by interacting with the environment, based on reward or penalty signals.

Throughout the history of AI development, reinforcement learning has undergone several major paradigm shifts, evolving from early mathematical theoretical derivations to becoming the core engine driving large language models and embodied AI today.
